podcast.body: Inspired by the college campus streaking fad, Ray Stevens wrote and recorded this song after reading an article about the phenomenon. Although many other songs on the topic existed, radio favored his version. It took only six weeks to reach number one on the Billboard Hot 100 on May 18th, 1974, where it stayed for three weeks, preventing The Jacksons Five's "Dancing Machine" from reaching the top spot. The song is characterized by its humor, format play, and ability to tap into a cultural fad, though it's not considered to have lasting power. "It took a mere six weeks for the streak to make it to number one the week of May 18th 1974 it stayed there for three weeks."
